headline_item.title_zh: 美国农业部遭遇网络攻击，涉农民支付系统安全
headline_item.title_en: Sources: hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture's system that facilitates payments to farmers this week (Julia Ainsley/NBC News)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国农业部本周遭遇网络攻击，引发针对关键农产品支付系统及敏感数据保护的严峻合规担忧
headline_item.event_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) suffered a cyberattack this week, impacting the core system responsible for processing payments to farmers. This breach raises significant concerns regarding the compromise of sensitive data and the vulnerability of critical federal infrastructure to sophisticated cyber threats.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国农业部（USDA）在美国联邦农业支付处理系统：遭遇恶意网络入侵，存在敏感个人及财务数据泄露风险
【起因与机理】作为国家粮食安全与农业经济核心枢纽，农业部系统成为网络攻击的高价值目标
【核心事实细节】核心事件：美国农业部遭受网络入侵导致支付系统安全受损。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：引发政府部门对关键基础设施数字资产保护及数据合规性的严苛审查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA): Cyberattack resulting in potential exposure of sensitive financial and personal data
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Targeting of essential national food and economic security infrastructure
[Key Fact Detail] Core incident: USDA hit by a cyberattack compromising payment system integrity.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Impact: Triggers immediate scrutiny over digital asset protection and compliance across federal critical infrastructure.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 此次攻击凸显了联邦部门在数字化转型进程中，核心业务流程向云端迁移后的合规性与边界防御盲区。农业支付系统作为国家粮食安全供应链的数字孪生，一旦被篡改或瘫痪，将直接引发行业信用体系动荡，其暴露的防御短板需警示关键基础设施运营商对分布式系统进行深度安全加固。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: This breach highlights the security blind spots and compliance risks faced by federal agencies during digital transformation. As the digital proxy for agricultural supply chain security, the compromise of payment systems signals a systemic vulnerability that necessitates immediate, hardened security protocols for all critical infrastructure distributed networks.

headlines.title_zh: 人工分析称 Inkling 2 Mini 具有 5.4B 的活动参数，其智能指数与 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) 相匹配，但活动参数少约 5 倍（人工分析）
headlines.title_en: Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)
headlines.event_summary_zh: Thinking Machines推出具备5.4B激活参数的Inkling 2 Mini模型，在保持高性能的同时显著降低计算成本
headlines.event_summary_en: Thinking Machines has released the open-weights Inkling 2 Mini model, utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 26B total and 5.4B active parameters. By employing looped Transformer layers, the model achieves performance parity with Qwen3.8 27B while utilizing only 20% of the active parameters, all under an Apache 2.0 license.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Thinking Machines（模型开发机构）：发布Inkling 2 Mini开源模型，实现高效推理架构
【起因与机理】在帕累托前沿提升模型智能与计算资源使用的匹配度
【关键数据与实测】计算效率对比：较Qwen3.8 27B减少约5倍激活参数及2.8倍计算功耗。
【各方立场与态度】采用26B总参数、5.4B激活参数的MoE循环架构，支持1M上下文。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thinking Machines: Released Inkling 2 Mini with high efficiency MoE architecture
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To improve Pareto frontier efficiency between model intelligence and compute cost
[Key Metrics] Features 26B total/5.4B active MoE looped architecture with 1M context window.
[Key Position & Outlook] Efficiency: achieves parity with Qwen3.8 27B using ~5x fewer active parameters and ~2.8x less compute.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 循环Transformer技术通过高频复用固定参数层，在不显著增加显存负担的前提下有效提升了模型的逻辑推演能力。这一架构演进标志着开源模型正跨越参数堆叠的粗放阶段，进入以计算成本为核心竞争力、追求帕累托最优的精细化部署时期。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The use of looped Transformer layers successfully enhances logical reasoning without linearly scaling memory overhead, signaling a shift in open-weights model design toward compute-efficient Pareto optimization. This approach highlights that future model deployment competition will center on maximizing intelligence density per unit of compute rather than mere parameter scaling.

headlines.title_zh: Cognition AI洽谈20亿美元融资，估值飙升至750亿美元
headlines.title_en: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
headlines.event_summary_zh: 人工智能初创企业Cognition AI正在寻求新一轮融资，计划融资额逾20亿美元，投后估值预计达750亿美元
headlines.event_summary_en: AI startup Cognition AI is in advanced funding talks to raise over $2 billion, aiming for a $75 billion valuation. The company specializes in autonomous software-engineering agents capable of planning, coding, testing, and deploying software with minimal human intervention, marking a rapid valuation surge from $26 billion in May.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Cognition AI（人工智能软件工程代理研发企业）在一级市场风投融资流程：拟融资逾20亿美元，投后估值达750亿美元
【起因与机理】AI Agent赛道资本热度高涨及产品自主软件工程能力的商业潜力验证
【关键数据与实测】拟融资额度超过20亿美元，核心业务为自主软件工程代理。
【涉及范围与推进】资方包括Andreessen Horowitz、Accel及Founders Fund等顶级机构。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Cognition AI (AI software engineering agent developer): Seeking over $2 billion in funding at a $75 billion valuation
[Root Cause & Mechanism] High market appetite for autonomous agents and validation of autonomous coding capabilities
[Key Metrics] Aiming to raise over $2B for autonomous software engineering agent development.
[Scope & Next Steps] Backed by top-tier firms including Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and Founders Fund.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: Cognition AI在数月内实现估值跨越式膨胀，反映出资本市场已从大模型底座的博弈转向对具备业务闭环能力的AI Agent落地潜力的押注。这种高溢价融资将加剧AI应用层的马太效应，通过雄厚的资本储备加速对全栈工程自动化开发工具的垄断，进而对传统软件开发岗位及外包业务模式产生深层冲击。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The meteoric valuation of Cognition AI signals a pivot in venture capital from foundational LLMs to autonomous agents with tangible execution capabilities. This aggressive funding trajectory will likely entrench market dominance through capital-intensive R&D, accelerating the displacement of traditional software engineering workflows.

titans.name: Yann LeCun
titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
